_what_this_is: PROTOTYPE of a Tier-G (grounded, not human-reviewed) Pivota Insights bundle for Aruen Tofu Collagen — the product_intel.v1 shape the agent already consumes, produced by grounded synthesis (verified INCI + ingredient mechanism + cited science + per-claim grading), so it can surface to agents WITHOUT per-SKU human review. This is what an agent would get for a long-tail cohort SKU that has no human-reviewed bundle today (it currently gets nothing).

what_it_is.headline: Vegan fermented-soy firming gel-cream — the active story is soy isoflavones, not the 'collagen' in the name
what_it_is.body: A jelly moisturizer whose firming driver is fermented soy (genistein/daidzein isoflavones) plus adenosine, with niacinamide for tone and a Lactobacillus postbiotic for barrier. Best for mature / elasticity-focused skin; gentle and gradual.

not_fit.label: Very dry skin needing rich occlusion

why_it_stands_out.headline: Fermented soy isoflavones — a real firming mechanism
why_it_stands_out.body: Genistein/daidzein up-regulate type-I procollagen and inhibit the MMPs that break collagen down — a plant-based firming route, distinct from a generic peptide cream.

why_it_stands_out.headline: Fermented for bioavailability (Korean lineage)
why_it_stands_out.body: Lactic-acid fermentation converts isoflavone glucosides into the active aglycone forms and adds postbiotics — the doenjang/cheonggukjang fermented-soy tradition applied to skincare.

why_it_stands_out.headline: Niacinamide + adenosine support tone and smoothness
why_it_stands_out.body: Niacinamide for even tone and barrier; adenosine for the look of smoothness.

evidence_claims.claim: Helps firm and improve the look of elasticity
evidence_claims.mechanism: isoflavones up-regulate procollagen + inhibit MMP collagen breakdown; adenosine supports smoothing
evidence_claims.caveat: strongest in mature / estrogen-deficient skin; gradual (weeks)

evidence_claims.claim: It's a 'collagen' cream that builds collagen
evidence_claims.finding: Topical hydrolyzed collagen is too large to reach the dermis; it hydrates the surface, it does not build collagen. The name overstates the collagen ingredient — the firming is isoflavone/adenosine-driven.

evidence_claims.claim: Brightens / evens tone and supports the barrier

pairing_notes: layer a richer occlusive over it in winter for very dry skin

watchouts.label: Under-hydrates very dry skin / harsh winter

provenance._why: This bundle is trustworthy by CONSTRUCTION (verified facts + citations), not by a human spot-check — so it can scale to the long-tail cohort. The tiered gate accepts tier='grounded' below human-reviewed and above ungrounded LLM.

field_sources.community_signals: absent (no aggregated reviews yet for this SKU)

_gate_note: Today isHumanReviewedProductIntelBundle would REJECT this (no human marker) → the agent gets nothing for Aruen. The proposed tiered gate accepts provenance.tier='grounded' + grounding.inci_verified + citations_present, surfaced at confidence='grounded' with the provenance shown — which is what unlocks the whole long-tail cohort.
